ORAL ORDER 4 08-11-2023 Heard Mr. Milind Kumar Mishra, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
The informant is represented by Mr. Brajesh Kumar Singh.

2. The petitioner happens to be the husband of the informant apprehending his arrest in connection with Tr. No. 2226 of 2023 arising out of Complaint Case No. 242C of 2023, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 323, 341, 498A, 504/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. The marriage of the petitioner was solemnized with the complainant on 07.05.2021 as per the Hindu rites and customs, however, soon after the marriage she was subjected to demand of dowry and on account of non-fulfillment of the same Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.55956 of 2023(4)
dt.08-11-2023 she was tortured in various ways and ultimately she has been ousted from the matrimonial home, resulting into lodging of the present complaint.

4. At the outset, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the present complaint is instituted on account of some differences as has arisen between the couples and now the petitioner is ready to keep the opposite party no. 2 as his wife with full love, affection and dignity.

sentences.text: At this juncture, learned counsel for the informant submits across the Board that the informant also wants to live with the petitioner, if he mends' his ways and would not indulge in such type of activity in future.
On the instruction of the respective parties, learned counsel submit that there is a chance of amicable settlement and as such the matter may be sent to the Mediation Centre, Patna High Court.
6. In view of the submissions made on behalf of the parties, let the matter be sent to the Mediation Centre, Patna High Court.
The parties are directed to ensure their presence on 30.11.2023 before the learned Mediator, Mediation Centre, Patna High Court.

The learned Mediator shall after giving proper opportunity of hearing to both the sides, try to resolve the dispute amicably and submit the report preferably within a Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.55956 of 2023(4) dt.08-11-2023 period of four weeks, thereafter.

7. Re-notify this case on 16.01.2023.
8.
In the mean time there shall be no coercive action against the petitioner till further order.

(Harish Kumar, J) supratim/-
